name: Both-Shores Fractionally Representable Ample Classes Definition
statement: For a finite nonempty ample $C\subseteq Q_X=\{0,1\}^X$, let $I(C)=\{(v,S):v\in C,\ Q(v,S)\subseteq C\}$, where $Q(v,S)$ fixes the coordinates outside $S$ at $v$. The matrix $M_C$ has one row per distinct positioned cube $B\subseteq C$ and entries $M_C(B,(v,S))=\mathbf1\{v\in B,\operatorname{dir}(B)\subseteq S\}$. Write $\mathcal A(C)=\{\mu\ge0:M_C\mu=\mathbf1\}$. Both $\mathcal A(C)$ and $\mathcal A(Q_X\setminus C)$ are nonempty.
hypotheses: Finite nonempty ample classes on the full specified ambient cube, including original constant coordinates. Empty complementary shores have the unique empty allocation. Ordinary witnesses are the integral points of the full native allocation system.
